## R Markdown



```{r}
library(BallMapper)
#load dataset
data <- read.csv("C:/Users/ljack/Documents/ALLWAVE normal.csv",
                 check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

#Define Embedding Variables (The Shape)
embedding_cols <- c("Population Density",
                    "Median Age 2019",
                    "GVA",
                    "Average Gross Pay",
                    "GDP per Capita",
                    "Average Annual Hours Worked")

data_to_normalize <- data[, embedding_cols]

#log transform & normalize to reduce effect of outliers
cols_to_log <- c("Population Density", "GVA", "Average Gross Pay", "GDP per Capita")
for (col in cols_to_log) {
  if (col %in% names(data_to_normalize)) {
    data_to_normalize[[col]] <- log(data_to_normalize[[col]] + 1)
  }
}

norm_points <- as.data.frame(lapply(data_to_normalize, function(x) {
  (x - min(x, na.rm=TRUE)) / (max(x, na.rm=TRUE) - min(x, na.rm=TRUE))
}))
points <- as.matrix(norm_points)

case_columns <- c("Total confirmed cases of COVID-19 per million people  20/03/20",
                  "Total confirmed cases of COVID-19 per million people 24/08/20",
                  "Total confirmed cases of COVID-19 per million people 12/04/2021")
#titles for plots
plot_titles <- c("Start of Wave 1", "Start of Wave 2", "End of Wave 2")

#loop for different waves
for (i in seq_along(case_columns)) {
  col_name <- case_columns[i]
  plot_title <- plot_titles[i]
  
  if (col_name %in% colnames(data)) {
    print(paste("Generating plot for:", plot_title))
    
    # ball mapper construction
    values <- matrix(data[[col_name]], ncol = 1)
    BM <- BallMapper(points, values, epsilon = 0.275
                     )
    
    ColorIgraphPlot(BM)
    title(main = paste("Ball Mapper Graph -", plot_title))
    
    # extract countries in each ball
    ball_countries <- lapply(BM$points_covered_by_landmarks, function(indices) {
      data$Country[indices] 
    })
    
    ball_map <- data.frame(
      Wave = plot_title,
      Ball_ID = seq_along(ball_countries),
      Countries = sapply(ball_countries, function(x) paste(x, collapse = ", "))
    )
    
    # print ball to country map
    cat("\n--- Ball to Country Mapping for:", plot_title, "---\n")
    print(ball_map)
    
    # output latex table
    cat("\n\\begin{table}[h]\n")
    cat("\\centering\n")
    cat("\\begin{tabular}{|c|c|p{8cm}|}\n")
    cat("\\hline\n")
    cat("Wave & Ball ID & Countries \\\\\n")
    cat("\\hline\n")
    
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(ball_map))) {
      cat(ball_map$Wave[j], " & ", ball_map$Ball_ID[j], " & ", ball_map$Countries[j], " \\\\\n")
      cat("\\hline\n")
    }
    
    cat("\\end{tabular}\n")
    cat("\\caption{Ball to Country Mapping for ", plot_title, "}\n")
    cat("\\end{table}\n\n")
  }
}

```
```{r}
library(BallMapper)

#load dataset
data <- read.csv("C:/Users/ljack/Documents/ALLWAVE normal.csv",
                 check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

#define embedding variables (the shape)
embedding_cols <- c("Population Density",
                    "Median Age 2019",
                    "GVA",
                    "Average Gross Pay",
                    "GDP per Capita",
                    "Average Annual Hours Worked")

data_to_normalize <- data[, embedding_cols]

#log transform & normalize to reduce effect of outliers
cols_to_log <- c("Population Density", "GVA", "Average Gross Pay", "GDP per Capita")
for (col in cols_to_log) {
  if (col %in% names(data_to_normalize)) {
    data_to_normalize[[col]] <- log(data_to_normalize[[col]] + 1)
  }
}

norm_points <- as.data.frame(lapply(data_to_normalize, function(x) {
  (x - min(x, na.rm=TRUE)) / (max(x, na.rm=TRUE) - min(x, na.rm=TRUE))
}))
points <- as.matrix(norm_points)

#colouring, log(Population Density)
values <- matrix(log(data[["Population Density"]] + 1), ncol = 1)

# ball mapper construction
BM <- BallMapper(points, values, epsilon = 0.3)

ColorIgraphPlot(BM)
title("Ball Mapper Graph coloured by log(Population Density)")
text(BM$vertices[,1], BM$vertices[,2],
     labels = seq_along(BM$vertices),
     pos = 3, cex = 0.7, col = "black")

```

```{r}
library(BallMapper)

#load dataset
data <- read.csv("C:/Users/ljack/Documents/ALLWAVE normal.csv",
                 check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

#define embedding variables (the shape)
embedding_cols <- c("Population Density",
                    "Median Age 2019",
                    "GVA",
                    "Average Gross Pay",
                    "GDP per Capita",
                    "Average Annual Hours Worked")

data_to_normalize <- data[, embedding_cols]

#log transform & normalize to reduce effect of outliers
cols_to_log <- c("Population Density", "GVA", "Average Gross Pay", "GDP per Capita")
for (col in cols_to_log) {
  if (col %in% names(data_to_normalize)) {
    data_to_normalize[[col]] <- log(data_to_normalize[[col]] + 1) # log transform
  }
}

norm_points <- as.data.frame(lapply(data_to_normalize, function(x) {
  (x - min(x, na.rm=TRUE)) / (max(x, na.rm=TRUE) - min(x, na.rm=TRUE))
}))
points <- as.matrix(norm_points)

#colouring, log(GDP per Capita)
if (!is.null(data[["GDP per Capita"]])) {
  values <- matrix(log(as.numeric(gsub(",", "", data[["GDP per Capita"]])) + 1), ncol = 1)
} else {
  stop("Dataset must contain a 'GDP per Capita' column.")
}

# ball mapper construction
BM <- BallMapper(points, values, epsilon = 0.3)

ColorIgraphPlot(BM)
title("Ball Mapper Graph coloured by log(GDP per Capita)")
text(BM$vertices[,1], BM$vertices[,2],
     labels = seq_along(BM$vertices),
     pos = 3, cex = 0.7, col = "black")

```
